assets.name: cave_map
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: portrait 9:16 fantasy RPG cave navigation map background. Reference 1 is the existing game's overworld map: match its detailed painterly pixel-art, miniature isometric elevated viewpoint, scale, terrain legibility and tall canvas. Reference 2 supplies the pitch-dark volcanic cave palette. Create a NEW underground cave map with no sky: a small cave entrance resting plaza at bottom center; from a central junction THREE clearly separate broad stone roads lead to distinct spacious destinations: left-middle a gigantic dead ancient tree and roots, upper middle an ancient iron ruin with rusted pillars, right-middle a horned beast's stone den. Also a SMALL ancient closed wooden door in a stone frame farther up, understated, reachable by a narrow winding footpath, not a fourth broad road. Show an intelligible connected cave environment with charcoal basalt, muted steel-blue rim lighting, tiny ember-red fissures, mist, uneven rock walls; paths visibly lighter than surrounding rocks. Leave clear space beside the entrance, three destinations, and door for later UI buttons. Keep top-right corner quiet for a later exit UI icon. No people, no full-size monsters, no drawn UI, NO lettering, labels, numbers, arrows or watermark. All essential landmarks comfortably within central 85% of canvas. Portrait composition matching the reference map.

assets.name: cave_entrance
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. NEW portrait 9:16 mobile fantasy RPG background, matching the supplied existing dark cave battle background's detailed painterly pixel-art. Somber, mysterious, anticipatory, colder and calmer than a boss arena. Natural perspective, tall ceiling lost in shadow. Keep center and lower center uncluttered, top-left and upper-center relatively quiet for HUD. No characters, creatures, weapons, tree, interface, text, writing, logos or watermark. Fully opaque scene, match reference portrait canvas.

assets.name: true_ending_hospital
assets.prompt: Create a portrait cinematic story illustration for the TRUE ENDING of the same game as the attached intro image. Preserve identity of the REAL-WORLD young adult male protagonist from reference: tousled dark brown hair, clean-shaven face, fair warm skin, same facial proportions, adult slim athletic build; he is NOT a fantasy avatar. Now he lies unconscious peacefully in a modern hospital bed, eyes closed, pale and weakened, wearing a modest pale blue hospital gown, white sheet to chest, nasal oxygen cannula, no injury or gore.
